results.title: Fire Damage Delays Installation of Simulated Lunar Greenhouse in Germany
results.summary:
A fire at an external contractor’s facility has delayed the installation of a containerised greenhouse designed to simulate growing crops on the Moon. According to a response to a parliamentary inquiry published by the German Bundestag on 20 October, a fire occurred while the EDEN-LUNA greenhouse container was being refurbished.
